description: This file contains functions and logic for configuring, setting up, and tearing down a QMI (Qualcomm MSM Interface) based cellular network interface using shell scripting. It includes initialization, connection setup, network registration, PIN verification, and protocol teardown procedures, specifically for use with the OpenWrt network management system.

methods.name: proto_qmi_init_config
methods.description: Initializes the configuration options for the QMI protocol, setting available options like device, APN, authentication, and profile parameters.

methods.name: proto_qmi_setup
methods.description: Sets up the QMI network interface, including device validation, SIM PIN handling, network registration, and establishing data connections for IPv4 and IPv6, then configures the network interface accordingly.

methods.name: proto_qmi_teardown
methods.description: Tears down the QMI network interface, stopping active network connections and releasing resources.

methods.name: qmi_wds_stop
methods.description: Stops a specific WDS (Wireless Data Service) client connection, releasing client IDs and stopping associated network profiles.
